# AWS Resource Access Manager cross-account access and invitations runtime

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Extend records-only resource shares to cross-account invitations, managed permissions, and real cross-account resource access.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] Resource share invitations and acceptance lifecycle
- [ ] Customer managed and AWS managed permissions
- [ ] Real cross-account resource authorization and sharing
- [ ] Integration with AWS Organizations sharing enablement

## Integration decisions

The current RAM API persists resource share configuration and associations records only; cross-account invitations and real authorization are excluded.
